source.reflectsPeriod: 2025-2026 rules (no dated instances; rules are stable across years)
source.basis: US Code 5 USC 6103 (federal holidays), NIST/US DOT daylight-saving rules (Uniform Time Act as amended 2005), typical K-12 and college academic calendars from state/district and university catalogs as recalled, BLS National Compensation Survey for paid-holiday prevalence, FLSA and FMCSA hours rules.

typical_start.doc: Clock time or a description (`varies`, rotating starts).

std_weekday_9_5.name: Standard office day
std_weekday_9_5.notes: Typical salaried or hourly office work; flextime and hybrid/remote variants common. 30-60 min unpaid meal inside the shift.

trades_day_7_330.name: Trades and construction day
trades_day_7_330.notes: Starts 06:00-07:30, ends 15:00-16:00; overtime and Saturdays common in busy season; weather-dependent in construction.

retail_rotating.name: Retail rotating shifts
retail_rotating.description: 4-8 h shifts, 4-6 days a week, schedule posted 1-2 weeks ahead
retail_rotating.notes: Opening, mid and closing shifts; weekends and holiday rushes included; hours vary week to week.

food_service_split.name: Restaurant and counter service
food_service_split.description: Lunch and dinner shifts, 4-6 per week
food_service_split.notes: Weekend and holiday heavy; closing shifts end 22:00-02:00; part-time common.

bar_night.name: Bar and nightlife
bar_night.notes: Shift runs about 17:00-02:00; Thursday-Saturday are peak.

three_12h.name: Three 12-hour shifts
three_12h.description: 3 x 12 h per week, day or night, rotating weekends
three_12h.notes: Hospital style: 07:00-19:30 days or 19:00-07:30 nights; 36 paid hours; extra shifts are overtime or per-diem.

four_10h.name: Four 10-hour shifts
four_10h.notes: Compressed week, usually Mon-Thu or Tue-Fri; common in pharmacy, manufacturing, warehouses and some trades.

shift_8h_rotating.name: Three 8-hour shifts, rotating
shift_8h_rotating.notes: 24/7 services; rotation or seniority bidding decides who works nights and weekends.

fire_24_48.name: 24 hours on, 48 hours off
fire_24_48.description: One 24 h shift (08:00-08:00) then 48 h off (about 2.33 shifts per week on average)
fire_24_48.notes: Average about 56 scheduled hours a week; sleep allowed between calls. Some departments use 48/96.

school_year_day.name: School-year day
school_year_day.notes: Summer, winter and spring breaks off (see school_year); pay is often spread across 12 months. Extra duties and grading outside hours.

academic_faculty.name: Faculty teaching load
academic_faculty.description: Teaching blocks Mon/Wed/Fri or Tue/Thu plus office hours and research
academic_faculty.notes: About 9-12 contact hours a week plus preparation and service; paid on a 9-month or 12-month basis; summers lighter.

otr_trucking.name: Over-the-road trucking
otr_trucking.description: Weeks on the road, days at home
otr_trucking.notes: FMCSA hours-of-service: 11 h driving inside a 14 h window, 10 h off duty, 60/70 h cap over 7/8 days, 34 h restart. Paid per mile; typically 2-3 weeks out then 3-4 days home.

route_delivery_day.name: Local delivery route
route_delivery_day.notes: Regional or last-mile courier: load-out at the depot, route stops, return; peaks in Nov-Dec.

warehouse_shifts.name: Warehouse and fulfillment shifts
warehouse_shifts.notes: Mandatory overtime during peaks; night shift differential 5-15%.

postal_route.name: Postal carrier route
postal_route.description: 6 days a week, rotating day off
postal_route.notes: Casual 8-10 h days, Saturdays included; parcels push hours up in December.

physician_clinic.name: Physician clinic plus call
physician_clinic.notes: Clinic 07:30-17:30 with charting after; call weekends or nights; hospital-based doctors use 3x12 or similar.

salon_by_appointment.name: Salon and personal services by appointment
salon_by_appointment.notes: Saturdays busiest; Sunday/Monday often closed; booth rent or commission common.

childcare_center_day.name: Childcare center day
childcare_center_day.notes: Center open about 06:30-18:00; staff work staggered open/close shifts.

gig_flexible.name: Gig and app work, self-scheduled
gig_flexible.notes: Demand peaks 07:00-09:30 and 16:00-19:00 on weekdays and Friday/Saturday 17:00-02:00; no guaranteed hours.

student_part_time.name: Student part-time
student_part_time.notes: Federal Work-Study / campus jobs cap at about 20 h a week in term; evenings and weekends.

summer_full_time.name: Summer full-time job
summer_full_time.description: Mon-Fri or retail schedule for 8-12 weeks
summer_full_time.notes: June-August seasonal work: camps, lifeguards, retail, landscaping.

seasonal_construction.name: Seasonal outdoor work
seasonal_construction.notes: Fewer paid weeks in cold climates; included in weeks_per_year.
